title: IoT pipeline overview
description: MQTT ingress -> TBMQ -> integration executor -> app Kafka -> telemetry-processor -> consensus -> ClickHouse.

panels.title: Data path freshness
panels.description: Age of the newest row in iot.detections: sensor -> TBMQ -> Kafka -> ClickHouse. Measured on insert time, so it stays honest when a sensor clock drifts.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, dateDiff('second', max(inserted_at), now())) AS seconds_behind
FROM iot.detections
WHERE inserted_at >= now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE

defaults.noValue: nothing stored in the last 10 min

targets.rawSql:
SELECT quantile(0.95)(ingest_latency_ms) / 1000 AS p95_seconds
FROM iot.detections
WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

SELECT count() AS rows
FROM iot.detections
WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE

panels.title: Sent vs received (msg/s through the whole path)
panels.description: Every stage of the pipeline; a gap between two lines is where messages are lost or queued.

panels.title: Simulator: drops, lag and clients
panels.description: Rates, the scheduler's worst lag and the MQTT client count share one axis; the lag series is seconds. clients connected < clients configured means a device session dropped.

panels.title: Last 20 vehicles (iot.vehicles, last 5 min)
panels.description: Fixed 5-minute window on ts_entry (partition key + minmax index) and LIMIT 20: cheap at a 10s refresh. Window is on device time, so a skewed sensor clock empties this.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ts_exit AS time, tunnel_id, direction, lane, classification,
  round(speed_kmh, 1) AS speed_kmh, round(length_m, 1) AS length_m, sensors, round(agreement, 2) AS agreement
FROM iot.vehicles
WHERE ts_entry >= now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE
ORDER BY ts_exit DESC
LIMIT 20

defaults.noValue: No vehicles fused in the last 5 min - check the simulator, or consensus calibration per tunnel.

panels.title: Last 20 rejections (iot.detections_rejected, last 15 min)
panels.description: Empty is the healthy state: rows here are payloads telemetry-processor refused.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT processed_ts AS time, reason, tunnel_id, client_cert_cn, substring(detail, 1, 120) AS detail
FROM iot.detections_rejected
WHERE processed_ts >= now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE
ORDER BY processed_ts DESC
LIMIT 20

defaults.noValue: No rejections in the last 15 min - every detection was accepted.

panels.title: Connection events/s

panels.description: KEDA scales the integration executors on this lag.

panels.title: End-to-end latency (iot.detections)
panels.description: sensor -> TBMQ, TBMQ -> telemetry-processor, TBMQ -> ClickHouse insert (ClickHouse SQL).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time,
  quantile(0.95)(mqtt_latency_ms) / 1000 AS mqtt_p95,
  quantile(0.95)(process_latency_ms) / 1000 AS processor_p95,
  quantile(0.95)(ingest_latency_ms) / 1000 AS clickhouse_p95
FROM iot.detections
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

defaults.noValue: No errors, exceptions or tracebacks in this range.
